**Finding**: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) Preload
**URL/Link**: https://about.doordash.com, https://admin-gateway.doordash.com, https://ads.doordash.com
**Why interesting**: HSTS preload prevents man-in-the-middle attacks by ensuring all communication to the site is encrypted. Missing it can lead to downgrade attacks.

**Severity**: HIGH
